name: BotDesk AI Chat
author: botdesk

sections.description:
BotDesk AI Chat adds your BotDesk AI chat assistant to your WordPress site. BotDesk answers your visitors’ questions and captures the leads you’d otherwise miss, plus booking requests on supported plans. It learns your business from your own website in about five minutes. When you’re closed, busy, or asleep, it keeps replying so a customer with a question doesn’t bounce to a competitor.

This plugin connects your WordPress site to your BotDesk account. You paste your BotDesk site key once, and the widget appears on the front end of your site. There is nothing to code.

What the assistant does for your visitors

  • Answers questions about your hours, services, and pricing, using your own site’s information.
  • Captures the visitor’s name, phone, and email along with what they asked, and emails it to you (up to 10 a month on the Free plan, unlimited on paid plans).
  • Routes ready-to-buy visitors toward booking an appointment (on supported plans).
  • Works around the clock, on any page of your site.

How it works

This is a companion plugin for the hosted BotDesk service at botdesk.studio. You need a BotDesk account and its site key. The plugin injects the official BotDesk widget script (https://botdesk.studio/widget.js) into your site’s footer with your key. It does not make any server-side calls of its own. The widget loads in the visitor’s browser exactly as BotDesk’s standard one-line embed does.

Don’t have a BotDesk account yet? Start free at botdesk.studio. The Free plan needs no card. Paid plans start with your first month free (one per business, card required, nothing charged until day 31).

Third-Party Service Disclosure

This plugin relies on the BotDesk service, a third-party hosted product. When a visitor loads a page on your site, their browser loads the BotDesk widget script from https://botdesk.studio/widget.js, and chat messages the visitor sends are processed by BotDesk to generate replies. No data is sent by this plugin from your server; all communication is between the visitor’s browser and BotDesk.

  • Service: BotDesk, https://botdesk.studio
  • Terms of Service: https://botdesk.studio/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://botdesk.studio/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings → BotDesk.
  3. Paste your BotDesk key into API key. Find it in your BotDesk dashboard: open the Install tab, then Site key, and click Copy.
  4. Make sure Show widget is checked, and save.
  5. Visit your site. The chat button appears in the corner.
sections.faq:
Do I need a BotDesk account?

Yes. BotDesk is a hosted service. This plugin connects your site to your BotDesk account using your site key. You can start free at botdesk.studio.

Where do I find my key?

In your BotDesk dashboard, open the Install tab, then Site key, and click Copy. It starts with bd_. It is the same value as data-api-key in your install code.

Will this slow down my site?

The plugin adds one script tag to your footer, loaded with defer so it doesn’t hold up your page. The script is about 238 KB, about 73 KB compressed as sent to the browser, and it makes one small request to load your bot’s settings. It does not run any code on your server.

If you use WP Rocket’s “Delay JavaScript execution”, the chat button only shows once a visitor scrolls, taps or moves the mouse. To show it right away, add botdesk.studio/widget.js to WP Rocket’s “Excluded JavaScript Files”. The same goes for LiteSpeed Cache: add it to “JS Excludes” and “JS Deferred/Delayed Excludes” (Page Optimization, Tuning tab).

How do I remove the widget temporarily?

Uncheck Show widget on the settings page, or deactivate the plugin.

How do I remove BotDesk completely?

Go to Plugins, deactivate BotDesk AI Chat, then click Delete. Deleting removes the key and setting the plugin saved. Your BotDesk account, chats and leads are not touched; to close the account, cancel any plan from your BotDesk dashboard.

Does the plugin collect any data?

No. The plugin only stores your API key in your site’s options and prints the widget script. All chat data is handled by the BotDesk service in the visitor’s browser.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Wording: AI chat assistant. BotDesk doesn’t answer phone calls. Free plan leads now read 10 a month.
  • The settings page no longer says “live” for a key that can’t be real. It warns you and tells you where to copy the right one.

1.0.2

  • The widget script now loads with defer (WordPress 6.3 and later use the built-in loading strategy; older versions get the defer attribute added), so it doesn’t hold up your page.
  • The script tag carries data-cfasync=”false”, so Cloudflare Rocket Loader leaves it alone.
  • Settings page and description now say the Free plan takes up to 3 leads a month (it used to say leads were paid-only).
  • Tested with WordPress 7.1.

1.0.1

  • Clearer setup text: where to find your key in the BotDesk dashboard (Install tab, Site key).
  • Plan wording matches what each BotDesk plan includes.
  • Tested with WordPress 7.1.

1.0.0

  • Initial release. Adds the BotDesk widget to your site via your API key, with a settings page and an enable/disable toggle.
